name: @red-cup-engineering/weiqi-engine
description: Weiqi's deterministic game engine: rules, scoring, SGF, semantic move events, and a Cartridge replay adapter. It specializes the shared game-engine contract without duplicating its log or hash protocol.

deliberateEntries.reason: The kernel chokepoint that weiqi-content-checker's DEFAULT_KERNEL_PATH resolves through via import.meta.resolve, not a re-export convenience.

scripts.check: for f in src/*.mjs scripts/*.mjs test/*.test.mjs test/helpers/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
